title: ChargePoint Holdings, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: ChargePoint Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 14, 2026 announcing the appointment of Natella Novruzova as Chief Accounting Officer and Principal Accounting Officer, succeeding Mansi Khetani who remains CFO. This is a routine corporate governance filing reporting an internal accounting leadership change at a single publicly-traded company. The source contains no information related to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Natella Novruzova appointed Chief Accounting Officer and Principal Accounting Officer effective April 14, 2026
Ms. Novruzova, age 56, previously served as Vice President, Corporate Controller since June 2019
New annual base salary set at $355,000 with 40% target bonus opportunity
Mansi Khetani remains Chief Financial Officer and Principal Financial Officer
Company is ChargePoint Holdings, Inc. (ticker: CHPT), an EV charging infrastructure company traded on NYSE
Filing signed by CFO Mansi Khetani on April 17, 2026
